name: Landhaus Gerber
beschreibung: Landhaus Gerber welcomes holidaymakers to the sunlit high valley of Wildschönau in the Kitzbühel Alps. Its peaceful setting surrounded by nature provides an ideal haven for travelers seeking rejuvenation. Beautifully styled in Tyrolean country aesthetics, the guest rooms and self-catering apartments feature private balconies with unobstructed alpine panoramas. An on-site sauna offers restorative warmth after exploring the outdoors. In summer, scenic hiking routes depart directly from the doorstep, while winter brings seamless ski shuttle service to the slopes of Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine retreat in Wildschönau featuring scenic balconies, a sauna, and direct nature access.
